newsitem.title: GERMANY: Reuters German Advertising & Media Digest - Apr 16.
newsitem.headline: Reuters German Advertising & Media Digest - Apr 16.

text.p: News from the Reuters and the German press on Advertising, Marketing, Brand-name Products, Media and the Internet
WOLFSBURG - Volkswagen says the first new advertising campaign under a recently renewed ad account with Duesseldorf agency DDB Needham will be to unveil its new VW Golf model. (Reuter)
FRANKFURT - The German advertisers' association (GWA) reorganises its media board. (Reuter)

GUETERSLOH - Media group Bertelsmanmnn says its plans to offer network services abroad using Internet technology. The company says it will work with U.S.-based ANS Communications to form European subsidiaries which would offer large customers telecommunication services. (Reuter)
STUTTGART - Most German publishers do not believe the boom in

electronic media has harmed their traditional business, says industry survey. The poll was conducted by the Fraunhofer Institute for Labour Market and Organisation (IAO), in which 500 German publishers were asked to give their views on trends in the industry in light of the rise of electronic news media in publishing. (Reuter)
